name: Champions Park
demographics: Champions Park attracts a diverse demographic mix reflective of Arlington's entertainment district, including families visiting nearby AT&T Stadium, Globe Life Park, and Six Flags, as well as young professionals and sports enthusiasts. The trade area benefits from high-income visitors drawn to major sporting events and entertainment venues, with household incomes typically ranging from middle to upper-middle class. The center serves both local residents seeking convenient dining and services, as well as tourists and event-goers looking for quick-service options near Arlington's premier attractions. Shopping patterns are heavily influenced by event schedules at nearby stadiums, creating peak traffic during game days and entertainment events.
description: Champions Park is a premier retail destination strategically positioned in the heart of Arlington's world-renowned entertainment district at the regionally significant intersection of I-30 and North Collins Street. With exceptional visibility to approximately 167,440 vehicles per day, this shopping center serves as the go-to location for dining, services, and entertainment for visitors to D-FW's major attractions including AT&T Stadium, Globe Life Park, and Six Flags Over Texas. The property features opportunities fronting North Collins Street, offering tenants unparalleled exposure to the massive traffic generated by Arlington's sports and entertainment venues. Managed by SHOP Companies, a leading retail real estate firm with offices across Texas and Oklahoma, Champions Park benefits from professional management and strategic positioning in one of the most dynamic retail corridors in the Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex. The center's location makes it an ideal destination for both local residents and the millions of tourists who visit Arlington's entertainment district annually, creating a unique blend of convenience retail and destination shopping.
summary: Champions Park is a retail center strategically located in Arlington's entertainment district with frontage on North Collins Street, benefiting from 167,440 vehicles per day at the I-30 intersection. Positioned near AT&T Stadium, Globe Life Park, and Six Flags, it serves as a prime destination for dining and services for both local residents and visitors to the area's major attractions.
